text:
maria: Heads up — new quantized candidate (q8-release-3) looks cheaper but the dashboard compare shows a 6.8% drop in our QA F1 aggregate vs baseline. spotted in /dash/compare -> model-deltas.
ken: ack, link? can you paste the compare URL or screenshot?
maria: https://console.redwood/model-compare?q=baseline, q8-release-3 — see the big red bar under "QA-F1 (weighted)". The diff panel also shows several severe per-slice regressions but the drilldown table is empty when I click the slice.
lia: hmm empty drilldown table sounds like the drilldown query is returning 0 rows. that UI bug was around pagination once, but we patched it. @eval-runner-bot did the run complete normally?
eval-runner-bot: run 2026-03-16-17:22 finished. status: completed. artifacts: s3://evals/2026/03/16/20260316-1722-q8-release-3.tar.gz. metrics computed: QA-F1, EM, BLEU, perplexity. checksum ok.
aj: i pulled the artifacts and ran our local compare script. Aggregates match the dashboard numbers but per-example alignments are off — the runner appears to have dropped trailing whitespace in references when quantization is enabled.
sarah: dropped whitespace? that would change EM/QA-F1 for short answers. any logs showing tokenization differences?
aj: yes, snippet from the harness stdout:
```
2026-03-16T17:18:03Z INFO: loading model q8-release-3
2026-03-16T17:18:09Z WARN: kv-cache init path=/mnt/runner/cache size=0x0 -- fallback to cpu cache
2026-03-16T17:18:11Z DEBUG: postprocess: strip_trailing_ws=true
2026-03-16T17:18:11Z DEBUG: tokenizer: normalize_utf8=false
```
aj: looks like a postprocess flag got flipped in the quantized runner branch. strip_trailing_ws=true was inadvertently enabled for q8 builds.
lia: that would explain empty drilldowns too — the drilldown SQL JOIN expects exact-match keys to link predictions -> examples, and if references are normalized differently the join returns no rows.
ken: can we reproduce by re-running runner with strip_trailing_ws=false locally?
maria: i kicked off a repro job on staging with the flag disabled. job id: staging-20260316-1740.
ops-bot: deploy started: runner-staging (tag: staging-20260316-1740). ETA ~2m.
aj: quick test locally toggling the flag fixes per-example EM for the problematic slice. aggregate F1 returns to within +-0.2% of baseline.
sarah: great. what's the root cause? a config merge in the quantize branch?
lia: looking at the PR that added q8 config (PR #8421) — the default postprocess block was copied and a comment removed. config key spacing caused YAML loader to treat the value as a boolean true vs the intended dictionary. i can open a tiny PR to fix.
ken: thanks. besides fixing the config, we should add a CI integration test to catch postprocess / tokenizer drift between model variants. maybe a smoke eval that asserts example-level join cardinality > 99%.
maria: agree. i'll draft a test in eval-harness CI that runs a tiny sample (100 examples) across baseline and quantized candidate and asserts (1) avg tokenized len diff < 2, (2) example join rate >= 0.995, (3) QA-F1 delta within configured slack.
aj: also add a runner metric exported when postprocess normalization != canonical default. expose as gauge `runner.postprocess.normalization_mismatch` so our dashboard alerting can pick it up.
lia: PR #8429 opened to revert the bad config and add a unit for the YAML loader edge case.
maria: deployed staging repro finished — numbers match baseline now and drilldown table rows are present. copying snippet: "drilldown rows: 124 / 126 (98.4%)" on the slice that previously showed 0.
ken: can we backfill dashboard for the q8 run (recompute metrics from artifacts) so the public compare shows fixed numbers?
sarah: yes, backfill job queued (job id backfill-20260316-1750). will rerun aggregation only.
ops-bot: backfill job started: backfill-20260316-1750. will notify on completion.
maria: thanks all. action items:
- lia: merge PR #8429 and patch config linting in the q8 pipeline
- aj: add runner metric + alert
- ken: add CI smoke eval and join-rate assertion
- sarah: monitor backfill and mark compare green when done
- maria: follow up with product about communicating quantize rollout note in the changelog
ken: thumbs up. any risk of this hitting prod customers who already used q8-release-3?
sarah: only if they used our hosted endpoint with the new image; rollout was canaryed but we should notify accounts with early access. i'll draft an email.
maria: closing the thread once backfill passes. :thumbsup:
